name: BMES
old_description: BMES has specialized in patient monitor and telemetry repair since 1989. Our depot repair services keep your equipment in top shape with flat-rate pricing, 3-5 day turnaround, and a 6-month warranty on every repair.
about:
BMES operates its national repair center in Louisville, Kentucky, minutes from the UPS Worldport hub. The company was founded in 1989 with a focus on relational service and a people-matter culture, though founder names and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides depot repair services for patient monitors, telemetry transmitters, infusion pumps, bedside modules, O2 blenders, suction regulators, and fetal transducers. Every device undergoes a 7-Step Critical Care Process that includes decontamination, component-level board repair, OEM-spec calibration, and quality-control verification. BMES also sells refurbished equipment and medical accessories such as cables, leads, and test equipment. The Louisville facility serves a nationwide customer base and reports a 95% first-pass repair success rate at flat-rate pricing.

Customers include hospital biomedical departments and healthcare systems such as UK HealthCare, University of Louisville Health, Tampa General Hospital, and Mt. Carmel New Albany Surgical Hospital. The company focuses exclusively on the biomedical equipment repair sector, serving facilities that cannot afford downtime on critical monitoring and infusion devices.

BMES was started to reduce equipment downtime with quality repairs, summarized in its purpose "Keeping Equipment Healthy for Patient Care." Differentiators cited by the company include a dedicated account representative for each facility, free shipping labels with UPS pickup, a 3-5 business day turnaround on core repairs, and a six-month Confident Care Warranty that covers the entire device rather than just the repaired component.
